title: Agatha Moreira and Rodrigo Simas Shine at Rock in Rio After Volleyball Victory
seoTitle: Agatha Moreira & Rodrigo Simas Shine at Rock in Rio
subtitle: The acting couple enjoys the festival, talks about their telenovelas, and celebrates a volleyball championship title
excerpt: Agatha Moreira and Rodrigo Simas arrived at Rock in Rio after winning a beach volleyball tournament, showing great chemistry and discussing the reception.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Agatha Moreira and Rodrigo Simas arrived at the first day of Rock in Rio still buzzing from their victory in a beach volleyball championship in Barra de Botafogo. The win and their presence at the festival drew even more attention from the crowd.

Beach volleyball championship and the festival celebration

The actress, who plays Ingrid in "Quem Ama Cuida", shared that she won the tournament at Botafogo beach over the weekend, supported by her boyfriend and friends from their weekly training sessions in Barra da Tijuca. "I still can't believe it," she joked when announcing the victory on social media.

Meeting friends in the VIP area

Upon entering the gates of the Rock in Rio VIP area, Agatha and Rodrigo met long-time friend Giovanna Lancellotti and posed for photographers wearing T-shirts featuring the event's logo. The group highlighted the importance of sports as a gathering point: "It also became a way to get together with friends. We have a little volleyball group and became very close," Agatha explained.

Connection to the soap opera and audience reaction

During the interview, the actress celebrated the impact of the 9 p.m. telenovela, stating she was "very happy" with the viewers' response. Rodrigo, who is part of the cast of the 6 p.m. telenovela "A Nobreza do Amor", reinforced the couple's chemistry as they greeted fans, posed for photos, and spoke with the press.

Concert expectations and festival style

Agatha revealed she was eager to see Foo Fighters, saying she was "dying to watch" them. Rodrigo added that the plan is to return on Sunday to see BaianaSystem and Black Rio. Regarding their looks, the actress prefers comfortable pieces that allow her to enjoy the entire day, highlighting boots as her favorite. Rodrigo agreed that "comfort" is the priority.

Volleyball as an emotional bond

For Agatha, beach volleyball brought contact with the sun, the sand, and the chance to take a dip before work, something that is "priceless." She also emphasized that sharing a passion for the sport brought the couple even closer, strengthening their relationship and their friendship with colleagues like Camila Queiroz.

With information from Globo, O Dia.
